finalists.label: Chronic Cicatricial Conjunctivitis
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including inferior symblepharon and cicatrization of the caruncle.

finalists.label: Atopic dermatitis
finalists.why: It is the only candidate in this group and has a specific finding of a chronic maculopapular rash suggestive of atopy or eczema.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of inferior symblepharon and cicatrization of the caruncle, which are specific and decisive findings, decided the final comparison in favor of Chronic Cicatricial Conjunctivitis.
